CharacterStyleRange.Content: (xi) Whilst VTRI prizemoney and bonuses on offer exceed $316 million, amounts reported exclude contributions from member clubs and other third parties, as well as amounts deducted and retained for equine, jockey and participant welfare contributions (which total 4% of prizemoney: 2% equine, 1% jockey, 1% participant). Noting participant contributions temporarily increased from 0.5% between 1 February 2024 and 31 July 2025.
(xii) Revised club funding arrangements from 1 August 2024 reflected a change in composition of some funding grants.
(xiii) Direct project management by racing clubs in reporting year.
(xiv) Participant welfare and workforce development. Participant welfare spend inclusive of commitment to support rising trainer Workcover premiums amongst other initiatives.
(xv) Investment in the welfare of thoroughbreds, including supporting a range of initiatives before, during and after racing.
(xvi) Owner initiatives. Reporting year inclusive of Australian Racing Museum support.
